Subject: Technical match & PoC checklist — streaming + funcalls + embeddings/rerank

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap of what we heard and a proposed PoC checklist so we can move to scoped next steps. I want to make sure we captured the pain correctly and that our proposed scope matches your engineering constraints.

Key pain points (as described):
- Current triage pipeline is slow at peak (95th %-ile latency spikes to ~1.2s per request) and that breaks downstream routing.
- Model outputs are freeform; your clinicians need strict, validated JSON for downstream EHR ingestion (structured outputs, field-level validation).
- Ranking candidate notes/answers from multiple retrieval sources is noisy — want embeddings + rerank to boost precision for top-3.
- Cost predictability: budget for steady-state inference and headroom during spikes.

Goals we agreed on:
1) PoC to validate streaming generation with function-calls to return structured JSON actions (e.g., {"action":"create_ticket","fields":{...}}) within your latency SLOs.
2) Evaluate embedding+rerank pipeline on a 10k-document sample and measure P@3 / latency.
3) Produce recommended runtime config (batching, caching, quantization profile) that meets your cost target.

Technical fit summary (quick):
- Streaming + function-calls: Redwood SDK supports streaming tokens + structured function-calling; we can emit validated JSON schemas and run server-side verification before returning to your service.
- Embeddings & rerank: we recommend embeddings for coarse retrieval and a lightweight reranker during the PoC (CPU-friendly candidate scoring or a small quantized model on GPU).
- Caching/KV: prefix caching for frequent prompts + KV cache to keep cold-start low on sessioned triage flows.
- Rollout: start with a staged PoC (sandbox) -> internal beta -> canary in production.

Proposed PoC checklist (owner / target):
- Sandbox access for Ardent test tenants (Marissa) — target by 2026-03-12.
- PoC dataset (10k docs, sample queries) from Ardent (Sarah/Tony) — deliver by 2026-03-17.
- Baseline latency/accuracy targets (we'll propose draft) (Grace) — draft by 2026-03-11.
- Redwood provides SDK snippets + sample function schema + poc-checklist PDF (Ben) — delivered simultaneous with sandbox.
- Weekly syncs during PoC (preferred: Tues 10am PT) (All)

Open questions for you:
1) Can you share a sanitized sample of the EHR payloads we must populate? Field list + validation rules will determine how much logic lives in function-calls vs. post-processing.
2) Expected RPS at peak and typical session length (tokens per session)? That will influence batching and instance sizing.
3) Any compliance constraints for running in a Redwood-hosted sandbox vs. private VPC?

Next steps (what I'll do):
- Ben will assemble SDK streaming + function-call snippets and the PoC checklist (attached).
- I'll schedule sandbox provisioning with Marissa and the infra team.
- Please confirm dataset delivery timeline and a point of contact for engineering access (API keys + sample S3).

Thanks — looking forward to running this PoC.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Appreciate it — we'll confirm dataset timing once Sarah has sanitized the sample.

I'll take the SDK snippets and a short tech runbook. Quick notes:
- For 120 RPS bursty, start with a 2x GPU pod setup with autoscale to 6x during the PoC; we'll benchmark and report cost delta.
- Batching: target 16ms batching window, adjust by observed tail latency.
- Function schema: attach a minimal JSON schema example and a Python streaming example in the zip.

Question for Ardent: can you share estimated average document length for the 10k sample (tokens/doc)? That will affect embedding compute and rerank latency.

I'll have the runbook and cost estimate by EOD Wed (2026-03-11 PST).
